metadata.name: rich-text-editor
metadata.description: Displays rich HTML content with a design-time toolbar (headings, bold/italic/underline, links, lists, images) for editing the underlying HTML via a text box, plus full typography/container styling controls.
features: Design-time toolbar for inserting headings, bold/italic/underline, links, lists, and images
Full container and typography styling (color, font, alignment, background, border)

properties.name: text
properties.defaultValue: Type or paste your content in the HTML Source box above, or use the toolbar buttons.

properties.name: textAlign
properties.description: Text alignment: left, center, right, or justify.

properties.name: showBorder
properties.description: Whether to show a border around the container.

properties.name: borderStyle
properties.description: Border style: solid, dashed, or dotted (when showBorder is true).

specifications: The toolbar and HTML source text box only render inside the WeWeb Editor (design time) — the published site renders the content via a static HTML display only.

Formatting is applied by selecting text in the HTML source box (via keyboard selection, e.g. Shift+Arrow or Cmd/Ctrl+A) and clicking a toolbar button, which wraps the selection with the corresponding HTML tag.
The `text` property is a raw HTML string; headings, paragraphs, lists, links, and images are all standard HTML tags rendered with built-in typography styling.
